payload.root_cause: Off-by-one in Inventory.reserve: the stock-sufficiency guard at pyshop/inventory.py:20 uses a strict comparison, `if self.available(sku) > qty:`. A request for exactly the remaining units (available == qty, e.g. 3 available, reserve 3) fails the guard, so execution reaches the else branch and raises OutOfStock at line 23 even though stock is sufficient. The correct check is `>=`, so reserving the full remaining quantity is accepted (leaving available at 0), while requests exceeding availability still raise OutOfStock. This contradicts the method docstring (line 17) and the README domain rule 'Reserving exactly the remaining stock is allowed.' `Inventory.available` (line 14) is correct (stock - reserved), and `release`/`restock` are unaffected, so this single inequality is the sole defect.
